mapper.sql: r.id, r.source, a.content, r.model_version, r.label, r.labeled_at, r.created_at
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) AS labeled_count, max(r.labeled_at) AS latest_labeled_at FROM expression_review r WHERE
SELECT FROM expression_review r JOIN answer a ON a.id = r.answer_id WHERE AND r.labeled_at <= #{until} ORDER BY r.labeled_at, r.id
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM expression_review WHERE answer_id IN (SELECT id FROM answer WHERE attempt_id IN (SELECT id FROM attempt WHERE student_id = #{studentId}))
mapper.update: UPDATE expression_review SET label = #{label}, labeled_by = #{labeledBy}, labeled_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO expression_review (id, answer_id, source, model_version, label, labeled_by, labeled_at, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{answerId}, 'GRAY_ZONE', #{modelVersion}, NULL, NULL, NULL, #{now}) ON CONFLICT (answer_id, source) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO expression_review (id, answer_id, source, model_version, label, labeled_by, labeled_at, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{answerId}, 'COMMUNITY_REPORT', NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, #{now}) ON CONFLICT (answer_id, source) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO expression_review (id, answer_id, source, model_version, label, labeled_by, labeled_at, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{answerId}, 'COMMUNITY_REPORT', NULL, #{label}, NULL, #{now}, #{now}) ON CONFLICT (answer_id, source) DO UPDATE SET label = EXCLUDED.label, labeled_at = EXCLUDED.labeled_at WHERE expression_review.labeled_by IS NULL AND expression_review.label IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.label
